ops.title: grade-void lane handoff: finder-void/fidelity-void design
ops.body:
Lane grade-void, brief /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/meta-desk-3/b/grade-void.md. Worktree /Users/yasyf/repos/claude/worktrees/cc-skills/grade-void (branch grade-void, from origin/main df5cfa1b9). Status at rotation: design settled, no edits yet.

Design:
- bus/legacy.go: CountedVoids parses `(finder|fidelity)-void #<n> at <40-hex sha>: <seq>` at a clause start, decide kind, lane exactly root or supervisor (same rule as CountedOverrides). LegacyFacts emits Fact{PR, head, machine.VoidFact(grader) = "void-<grader>", value = the decide's own record seq}.
- machine: VoidFact(grader); Facts gains FinderVoid, FidelityVoid int64 (fromStored parses them).
- store: factsAt and FactsAtRowHeads drop the grade fact when a void fact for that grader is present (beside dropWithdrawn). New prefix-matching delete; facts.putFacts deletes void-<grader> at the head whenever a finder/fidelity grade fact is ingested, so a newer grade replaces the void (PutFact's same-value upsert keeps the old posted time, so posted ordering cannot do this).
- facts/pushed.go: unfolded merge also masks voided grades.
- grading: Dispatch routes a voided grader to again(); again's key is max(first seq, void seq); a voided finder gets a whole pass (Head "") keyed by that seq, never the settled base pass (that would repost the voided ok); passBase matches. wholeJob's answered check ignores whole reads at or before the void.
- Why Finder becomes "" rather than not-clear: machine verdict then reads ActionGrade by the pool, not ActionVerdict to the lane.
- Skill: landing.md finder check paragraph (line ~306) and grading-principles.md first paragraph (~264).
Tests: bus legacy rows; facts harness (ok+void owes, new ok replaces, lane void ignored, old-sha void inert); grading Act on a voided head starts <pr>-whole-<voidseq> Full pass.
Ship: open-pr on yasyf/cc-skills; merge `ccx vcs merge <n> -R yasyf/cc-skills --admin --match-head-commit <full sha>`; post --kind landed to meta-desk-3 and install-desk.
